title: The Last Days
lead: The prophets spoke of "the latter days" when God would act decisively. The New Testament says those days began with Jesus and the gift of the Spirit, and will end at his return.

sections.b: "In the last days the mountain of the LORD's house will be established" (Isaiah 2:2; Micah 4:1). Hosea 3:5 says Israel will return to the LORD "in the last days," and Daniel 2:28 shows King Nebuchadnezzar "what will be in the latter days."

At Pentecost Peter says Joel's prophecy of "the last days" is happening now (Acts 2:16–17). Hebrews 1:2 says God has spoken "in these last days" by his Son, and 1 John 2:18 calls it "the last hour." The same writers warn that the last days bring scoffers and false teachers (2 Timothy 3:1–5; 2 Peter 3:3; Jude 18).
sections.refs: Acts 2:16–21; Hebrews 1:2; 1 Peter 1:20; 1 John 2:18; 2 Timothy 3:1–5; 2 Peter 3:3
